title: Counterfeit Versions of Eye Drops Found in Several States
summary: Counterfeit versions of over-the-counter eye drops have been found in Florida and Georgia in stores serving primarily Spanish-speaking customers. These products also may be in Louisiana, Mississippi, North Carolina and potentially other states.
